views.name: cards_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.artist AS artist,
  cards.cardKingdomId AS cardKingdomId,
  cards.cardKingdomFoilId AS cardKingdomFoilId,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.types AS types,
  cards.subtypes AS subtypes,
  cards.power AS power,
  cards.toughness AS toughness,
  cards.hasFoil AS isFoil,
  cards.hasNonFoil AS isNonFoil,
  cards.isReprint AS isReprint
FROM cards
grain: one row per card.id (one physical card row from cards table)
views.description: Normalized projection of the cards table exposing primary identifiers and common descriptive attributes used for filtering, display, and joins. Keeps raw values but standardizes column selection and nullability awareness.

views.name: cards_availability_identifiers
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.cardKingdomId AS cardKingdomId,
  c.cardKingdomFoilId AS cardKingdomFoilId,
  c.mtgoId AS mtgoId,
  c.mtgoFoilId AS mtgoFoilId,
  c.tcgplayerProductId AS tcgplayerProductId,
  c.availability AS availability,
  c.hasFoil AS hasFoil,
  c.hasNonFoil AS hasNonFoil
FROM cards AS c
grain: one row per card.id with marketplace identifier columns exposed

semantic_filters./* generic (no hard-coded literal) */: no filter; consumers will apply IS NOT NULL or other predicates

views.description: Cohort of cards that have external marketplace identifiers (non-null marketplace ids). Useful to find cards available in foil/non-foil markets and to filter by presence of identifiers.

views.name: card_set_lookup
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS card_id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  s.code AS setCode, -- keep set code from sets for clarity (will match c.setCode when present)
  s.name AS set_name,
  s.releaseDate AS set_releaseDate,
  s.type AS set_type,
  c.cardKingdomId AS cardKingdomId,
  c.cardKingdomFoilId AS cardKingdomFoilId,
  c.rarity AS rarity,
  c.artist AS artist
FROM cards_core c
LEFT JOIN sets s
  ON c.setCode = s.code
grain: one row per card.id joined to its set (cards.setCode = sets.code). If setCode is NULL or no match, row still represents the card with NULL set fields.
views.description: Denormalized join between cards and sets exposing set metadata (code, name, releaseDate, type) alongside card identifiers for queries that need set context.

views.name: cards_core_3
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.borderColor AS borderColor,
  cards.cardKingdomId AS cardKingdomId,
  cards.cardKingdomFoilId AS cardKingdomFoilId,
  cards.availability AS availability,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.text AS text
FROM cards
grain: one row per cards.id (one card printing row)
views.description: Base row-level view of cards with identifying and commonly used attributes for filtering, grouping, and display.

views.name: cards_availability_normalized
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  trim(lower(value)) AS availability_token
FROM cards c,
  json_each(
    CASE
      WHEN availability IS NULL OR trim(availability) = '' THEN '[]'
      WHEN substr(trim(availability),1,1) = '[' THEN availability
      ELSE
        json_quote('[' || replace(replace(replace(availability, ' ', ''), ';', ','), '/', ',') || ']')
    END
  )
grain: one row per cards.id per availability_token
views.description: Normalized availability tokens for each card row; explodes/standardizes the availability string into canonical rows or a normalized token list for easier filtering (e.g., 'paper', 'mtgo').

views.name: card_legalities_by_format
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  l.format AS format,
  l.status AS status
FROM cards_core c
JOIN legalities l
  ON l.uuid = c.uuid
grain: one row per cards.id per legality.format
views.description: Card-level legality records per format, joining card identity to its legalities for format-based filters and groupings.

views.name: cards_core_6
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.number AS number,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.colorIdentity AS colorIdentity,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.types AS types,
  cards.subtypes AS subtypes,
  cards.text AS text,
  cards.power AS power,
  cards.toughness AS toughness,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost,
  cards.originalReleaseDate AS release_date
FROM cards
grain: id -- one row per card printing (cards.id)
views.description: Canonical, cleaned projection of the cards table exposing card identifiers, printed attributes and common searchable fields (one row per card printing). Casts and canonicalization are minimal so it can be filtered/joined downstream.

views.name: card_legalities
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS legality_id,
  uuid,
  format,
  status
FROM
  legalities
grain: uuid, format -- each row describes status of a card (uuid) in a particular format
views.description: Normalized per-card-format legality rows. One row per (card uuid, format) showing the status in that format so queries can filter for specific formats/status like 'gladiator'/'Banned'.

views.name: card_printing_with_legalities
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.number AS number,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  legalities.id AS format_id,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status,
  legalities.id AS legality_id
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
grain: one row per cards.id combined with legalities.id (printing x format combination)
views.description: Denormalized join between card printings and their legalities. One row per card printing x legality format; useful to select printings that match both printing-level filters (rarity, set) and legality filters (format/status). Does not bake any specific format/status values.

views.name: cards_base_attributes
views.body_sql:

views.name: card_legalities_10
views.body_sql:

views.name: card_foreign_translations
views.body_sql:

views.name: cards_core_12
views.body_sql:
SELECT

views.name: card_legalities_13
views.body_sql:
SELECT

FROM legalities

views.name: cards_with_commander_legality
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,

JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
grain: one row per cards.id joined to each matching legalities row
views.description: Denormalized view joining card core attributes to their legalities, one row per card-printing x legality. Useful to produce cohorts of cards that are (or are not) legal in particular formats while keeping card attributes handy for filtering and projection.

views.name: cards_core_15
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  NULLIF(cards.uuid, '') AS uuid,
  NULLIF(cards.name, '') AS name,
  NULLIF(cards.artist, '') AS artist,
  CASE
    WHEN cards.hasContentWarning IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN cards.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS hasContentWarning,
  NULLIF(cards.manaCost, '') AS manaCost,
  NULLIF(cards.type, '') AS type,
  NULLIF(cards.types, '') AS types,
  NULLIF(cards.subtypes, '') AS subtypes,
  NULLIF(cards.text, '') AS text,
  NULLIF(cards.originalText, '') AS originalText,
  NULLIF(cards.flavorText, '') AS flavorText,
  NULLIF(cards.power, '') AS power,
  NULLIF(cards.toughness, '') AS toughness,
  NULLIF(cards.loyalty, '') AS loyalty,
  CASE WHEN cards.convertedManaCost = '' THEN NULL ELSE cards.convertedManaCost END AS convertedManaCost,
  NULLIF(cards.rarity, '') AS rarity,
  NULLIF(cards.setCode, '') AS setCode,
  NULLIF(cards.printings, '') AS printings,
  NULLIF(cards.availability, '') AS availability
FROM cards
grain: one row per cards.id (each card printing / row in cards table)
views.description: Normalized projection of the cards table exposing primary identifiers, key descriptive fields, and commonly used attributes; empty strings are normalized to NULL for easier detection of missing properties.

views.name: rulings_by_card
views.body_sql:
SELECT

  uuid,
  date,
  text
FROM rulings
grain: one row per rulings.id (a single ruling entry)
views.description: All rulings rows keyed by card uuid; one row per ruling. Useful to join rulings to cards and to aggregate rulings for each card.

views.name: cards_with_rulings_denorm
views.body_sql:
SELECT

  r.text AS ruling_text
FROM cards_core_15 AS c
LEFT JOIN rulings AS r
  ON r.uuid = c.uuid
grain: one row per (card.id, ruling.id) where ruling may be NULL if no rulings exist
views.description: Denormalized join of cards_core and rulings_by_card to provide card rows along with zero-or-more ruling rows; preserves one row per ruling (cards repeated when multiple rulings). Useful for queries that need card details together with all related rulings.

views.name: rulings_per_card
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  rulings.uuid AS uuid,
  COUNT(rulings.id) AS ruling_count,
  MAX(rulings.date) AS last_ruling_date
FROM rulings
WHERE rulings.uuid IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY rulings.uuid
views.description: Aggregate count of rulings per card UUID. Keeps one row per card UUID with raw count and optional last ruling date for ranking/filtering.

views.name: sets_basic_29

views.name: foreign_texts_by_uuid
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.uuid AS uuid,
  foreign_data.language AS language,
  foreign_data.text AS "text AS foreign_text",
  foreign_data.flavorText AS "flavorText AS foreign_flavor",
  foreign_data.id AS id
FROM foreign_data
views.description: Subset of foreign_data rows keyed by card uuid providing translated/localized oracle text and flavor text for cards; useful when primary card text is missing or for locale-specific lookups.

views.name: card_with_preferred_text
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  CASE
    WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(c.text, '')) <> '' THEN c.text
    ELSE fd.text
  END AS text,
  c.originalText AS originalText,
  fd.text AS foreign_text,
  CASE
    WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(c.text, '')) <> '' THEN 'cards'
    WHEN fd.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'foreign_data'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS source_table
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT fd1.*
  FROM foreign_data fd1
  JOIN (
    -- pick the first foreign_data row per uuid by lowest id
    SELECT uuid, MIN(id) AS min_id
    FROM foreign_data
    GROUP BY uuid
  ) fdmin ON fd1.uuid = fdmin.uuid AND fd1.id = fdmin.min_id
) fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
views.description: Denormalized view that returns each card with its preferred gameplay text: use cards.text when present/non-empty, otherwise pull the first matching foreign_data.text for that card (no language preference baked in). Exposes source_table indicating where the returned text came from.

views.name: cards_core_33
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  uuid,
  name,
  setCode,
  borderColor,
  colors,
  colorIdentity,
  rarity,
  type,
  types,
  subtypes,
  manaCost,
  convertedManaCost,
  -- releaseDate comes from the sets table via setCode; join performed to obtain canonical release date
  (SELECT releaseDate FROM sets s WHERE s.code = cards.setCode LIMIT 1) AS releaseDate
FROM cards
views.description: Canonical, cleaned projection of the cards table exposing primary identifiers and the common card attributes used for filtering, grouping and aggregation (one row per card row). Does minimal canonicalization (keeps raw values) so downstream queries can apply case-sensitive or case-insensitive filters as needed.

views.name: cards_bordercolor_cohort

views.name: card_story_spotlight_with_localizations
views.body_sql:
SELECT

  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",
  cards.name AS "cards.name",
  cards.setCode AS "cards.setCode",

views.name: cards_core_39
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.originalType AS originalType,
  -- normalize types: trim surrounding whitespace and collapse multiple commas/spaces
  TRIM(
    REPLACE(
      REPLACE(cards.types, ', ', ','),  -- unify separators
      ' ,', ','
    )
  ) AS types,
  TRIM(
    REPLACE(
      REPLACE(cards.subtypes, ', ', ','),
      ' ,', ','
    )
  ) AS subtypes,
  -- canonical single "type" field (use cards.type as-is but trimmed)
  TRIM(cards.type) AS type,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost
FROM cards
grain: id (one row per card row in cards table)
views.description: Normalized core card rows with canonical key columns and cleaned textual fields useful for filtering and tokenizing subtype/type information.

views.name: cards_with_subtype_presence
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.uuid,
  c.name,
  c.originalType,
  CASE
    WHEN c.subtypes IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        -- match exact subtype 'Angel' as whole token in comma/pipe/space separated lists
        ',' || REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.subtypes, '|', ','), ';', ','), '  ', ' ') || ',' LIKE '%,' || 'Angel' || ',%'
        OR ',' || REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.subtypes, ' ', ','), '|', ','), ';', ',') || ',' LIKE '%,' || 'Angel' || ',%'
        OR c.subtypes = 'Angel'
      )
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS has_Angel_subtype
FROM cards_core_39 AS c
views.description: Per-card boolean indicators for presence of specific subtype tokens (sparse indicator view). Useful for quickly filtering cards that have or lack particular exact subtypes.

views.name: cards_core_41
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.duelDeck AS duelDeck,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.colorIdentity AS colorIdentity,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.isReprint AS isReprint,
  cards.isOnlineOnly AS isOnlineOnly,
  cards.originalReleaseDate AS originalReleaseDate
FROM cards
views.description: Canonical, row-level card records with key identifiers and common attributes normalized for filtering and joining (keeps original fields as-is; converts obvious numeric/text types left to consumer). Useful as the base relation for most card-level queries.

views.name: card_legalities_42
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS card_id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized one-row-per-card-per-format legal status combining card identifiers with legality rows. Useful to filter cards by format legality or to aggregate legality status counts per card or set.

views.name: card_foreign_names
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS card_id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  foreign_data.language AS language,
  foreign_data.name AS foreign_name,
  foreign_data.text AS foreign_text,
  foreign_data.flavorText AS foreign_flavorText,
  foreign_data.id AS foreign_data_id
FROM cards
JOIN foreign_data ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Card translations / foreign-data rows joined to card identifiers to allow language-specific name/text lookups and filtering by language.

views.name: card_basic_attributes
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS id,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  -- canonicalize borderColor to lowercase for stable grouping; keep NULLs as-is
  LOWER(c.borderColor) AS borderColor,
  -- colors stored as text (comma-separated); normalize empty-string to NULL
  NULLIF(TRIM(c.colors), '') AS colors,
  -- colorIdentity stored as text; normalize empty-string to NULL
  NULLIF(TRIM(c.colorIdentity), '') AS colorIdentity,
  -- type as provided
  c.type AS type,
  -- rarity normalized to lowercase stable token
  LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(c.rarity), '')) AS rarity,
  -- manaCost preserved as-is for filtering/grouping
  NULLIF(TRIM(c.manaCost), '') AS manaCost
FROM cards_core_33 c
views.description: Normalized per-card basic attributes used for filtering and grouping (one row per card). Casts and canonicalizes common categorical fields and exposes stable identifiers.

views.name: card_legalities_45
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  legalities.id AS legality_id,
  legalities.uuid AS uuid,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status
FROM legalities
views.description: Per-card legality statuses across formats. One row per card-format legality record. Suitable for filtering cards by legality status or aggregating legalities by card.

views.name: cards_with_legalities_46
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS card_id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.borderColor AS borderColor,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.colorIdentity AS colorIdentity,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  legalities.id AS legality_id
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized view joining card basic attributes with their legality records. One row per card × format legality. Useful to filter cards by legality and card attributes together.

views.name: cards_core_47
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.originalType AS originalType,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.colorIdentity AS colorIdentity,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.types AS types,
  cards.subtypes AS subtypes,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost
FROM cards
grain: one row per cards.id (one row per card print entry)
views.description: One-row-per-card core card attributes useful for filtering and joining to translations, legalities, and sets.

views.name: card_foreign_translations_48
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS "cards.id",
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",
  cards.name AS "cards.name",
  cards.originalType AS "cards.originalType",
  cards.colors AS "cards.colors",
  foreign_data.id AS "foreign_data.id AS foreign_id",
  foreign_data.language AS "foreign_data.language",
  foreign_data.name AS "foreign_data.name AS foreign_name",
  foreign_data.text AS "foreign_data.text AS foreign_text",
  foreign_data.flavorText AS "foreign_data.flavorText AS foreign_flavorText",
  foreign_data.multiverseid AS "foreign_data.multiverseid"
FROM foreign_data
JOIN cards ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
WHERE foreign_data.language IS NOT NULL
grain: one row per foreign_data.id (each translation row related to a specific card uuid)
views.description: Denormalized relation linking cards to their foreign language translations (one row per foreign_data entry), exposing both card keys and translation fields for filtering and display.

views.name: card_legality_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  COUNT(l.id) FILTER (WHERE l.status IS NOT NULL) AS total_legal_rules,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT l.format) AS formats_list,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(l.status) = 'legal' THEN l.format END) AS legal_formats_list,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(l.status) = 'banned' THEN l.format END) AS banned_formats_list
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid
views.description: Per-card summary of legalities aggregated by format, exposing counts and a compact representation of formats where the card is legal/ban/etc. Useful for filtering cards by format legality.

views.name: cards_basic_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.layout AS layout,
  cards.frameVersion AS frameVersion,
  cards.borderColor AS borderColor,
  cards.availability AS availability,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  sets.releaseDate AS releaseDate,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.types AS types
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN sets ON sets.code = cards.setCode
grain: id -- one row per card printing (cards.id)
views.description: Row-level cohort of cards with commonly used identifying and printing attributes; useful as the base subset for filtering by layout, frameVersion, borderColor, availability, set, and other card-level filters.

views.name: cards_canonical_mana
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  CASE
    WHEN c.manaCost IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN trim(c.manaCost) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE trim(c.manaCost)
  END AS manaCost_canonical
FROM cards_core c
grain: id -- one row per cards.id with a cleaned manaCost field
views.description: Normalized projection of card manaCost with canonical null/empty handling and trimmed whitespace; exposes manaCost alongside stable identifiers for joining and deduping.

views.name: cards_with_foreign_and_legalities
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS "cards.id",
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",
  cards.name AS "cards.name",
  cards.manaCost AS "cards.manaCost",
  foreign_data.language AS "foreign_data.language",
  foreign_data.name AS "foreign_data.name AS foreign_name",
  legalities.format AS "legalities.format",
  legalities.status AS "legalities.status",
  foreign_data.id AS foreign_id,
  legalities.id AS legality_id
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN foreign_data ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
LEFT JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
grain: cards.id, foreign_data.id, legalities.id -- one row per (card, foreign_data, legality) join combination
views.description: Denormalized card-level relation joining cards to their foreign language variants and legalities for multi-lingual text or format-eligibility queries; keeps card identifiers and core attributes to support filtering then projecting manaCost.

views.name: cards_story_spotlight_flags_53
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.isStorySpotlight AS isStorySpotlight,
  cards.isTextless AS isTextless,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.rarity AS rarity
FROM cards
views.description: Row-level cohort of cards exposing story spotlight and textless flag plus primary identifiers and common card attributes for filtering and grouping. Use this as the base set when asking about story-spotlight or textless counts/ids.

views.name: cards_basic_identifiers
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  c.type AS type,
  c.rarity AS rarity,
  CAST(coalesce(c.isStorySpotlight, 0) AS INTEGER) AS isStorySpotlight,
  CAST(coalesce(c.isTextless, 0) AS INTEGER) AS isTextless,
  CAST(coalesce(c.isReprint, 0) AS INTEGER) AS isReprint,
  CAST(coalesce(c.isPromo, 0) AS INTEGER) AS isPromo
FROM cards AS c
views.description: Canonicalized basic identifier/projection of cards with common columns used across analytics; casts flags to integer and exposes textual attributes. Good for joins, dedup, and counting populations.

views.name: cards_story_spotlight_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  c.type AS type,
  COUNT(*) AS story_spotlight_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.isTextless = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS story_spotlight_textless_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.isStorySpotlight = 1
GROUP BY c.setCode, c.type
views.description: Pre-aggregated counts of story-spotlight cards and counts of those that are textless, grouped by optional dimensions (setCode, type). Keeps raw counts so final queries can compute percentages or drilldowns.

views.name: sets_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  code AS code,
  name AS name,
  block AS block,
  type AS type,
  releaseDate AS releaseDate,
  isFoilOnly AS isFoilOnly,
  isForeignOnly AS isForeignOnly,
  isOnlineOnly AS isOnlineOnly
FROM sets
views.description: One-row-per-set with canonical set identifying attributes and common filters preserved (keeps code, name, block, type, releaseDate and flags). Useful as the base cohort of sets to filter, join, and aggregate.

views.name: set_translations_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  setCode AS setCode,
  language AS language,
  translation AS translation
FROM set_translations
views.description: One-row-per-set-translation with language, setCode and translation text. Exposes the mapping between sets and their translations for filtering and joining.

views.name: sets_with_translations
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  sets.code AS code,
  sets.name AS name,
  sets.block AS block,
  sets.releaseDate AS releaseDate,
  sets.type AS type,
  set_translations.language AS set_translation_language,
  set_translations.translation AS set_translation_text,
  sets.id AS sets_id,
  set_translations.id AS set_translations_id
FROM sets
JOIN set_translations
  ON set_translations.setCode = sets.code
grain: setCode + set_translation_id (one row per set translation)
views.description: Denormalized relation linking sets to their translations: one row per (set, translation) with canonical set attributes plus translation language and text. Useful for questions that count or list sets by translation languages or filter sets by available translations.

views.name: cards_basic_types
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS card_id,
  NULLIF(trim(c.supertypes), '') AS supertypes,
  NULLIF(trim(c.subtypes), '') AS subtypes
FROM cards AS c
views.description: Normalized per-card type fields exposing supertypes and subtypes as separate nullable text columns, trimmed and coerced to NULL when empty. Keeps card identifiers for joins.

views.name: foreign_cards_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS card_id,
  f.language AS foreign_language
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data f
  ON f.uuid = c.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid, c.id, f.language
views.description: Cohort of cards that have at least one foreign_data row, with language and the foreign_data.uuid for joining. Includes card identifiers and links to language-specific foreign entries.

views.name: cards_text_and_power
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS id,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  -- prefer a core view that exposes preferred text; fall back to cards table column names present in schema
  COALESCE(c.text, cards.text, '') AS text,
  COALESCE(c.originalText, cards.originalText, '') AS originalText,
  COALESCE(c.power, cards.power, '') AS power,
  COALESCE(c.toughness, cards.toughness, '') AS toughness,
  COALESCE(c.types, cards.types, '') AS types,
  COALESCE(c.type, cards.type, '') AS type
FROM
  -- prefer cards_core_30 which provides uuid,name,text,originalText,setCode,id
  (SELECT id, uuid, name, text, originalText, setCode, NULL AS power, NULL AS toughness, NULL AS types, NULL AS type FROM cards_core_30)
  AS c
LEFT JOIN
  cards
  ON cards.uuid = c.uuid
grain: uuid -- one row per card face/record
views.description: Row-level view of cards exposing identifiers, textual fields and power/toughness so downstream queries can filter by text content and by whether power is known.

views.name: cards_canonical_text
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS id,
  COALESCE(LOWER(c.name), '') AS name,
  COALESCE(LOWER(c.setCode), '') AS setCode,
  COALESCE(LOWER(c.text), '') AS text_normalized,
  COALESCE(LOWER(c.originalText), '') AS originalText_normalized
FROM cards AS c
grain: uuid -- one row per card record
views.description: Canonicalized textual fields for cards: normalized lower-cased text fields with NULLs coalesced to empty string to simplify case-insensitive searching and pattern matching.

views.name: cards_power_unknown_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS id,
  c.name AS name,
  c.power AS power,
  -- power_unknown is true when power is NULL or empty string or a known unknown marker like '*' or '—'
  CASE
    WHEN c.power IS NULL THEN 1
    WHEN trim(c.power) = '' THEN 1
    WHEN c.power IN ('*', '—', '-', '?') THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS power_unknown
FROM cards_core c
grain: uuid -- one row per card record
views.description: Cards with a derived boolean flag indicating whether the power is unknown (NULL or special unknown markers like '*'), useful for filtering cohorts of creatures or other cards missing power values.

views.name: cards_core_64
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.side AS side,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.types AS types,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.colorIdentity AS colorIdentity,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  CASE WHEN cards.isReprint IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN cards.isReprint = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isReprint,
  CASE WHEN cards.isPromo IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN cards.isPromo = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isPromo,
  CASE WHEN cards.isOnlineOnly IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN cards.isOnlineOnly = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isOnlineOnly,
  CASE WHEN cards.isFullArt IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN cards.isFullArt = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isFullArt,
  CASE WHEN cards.hasFoil IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN cards.hasFoil = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS hasFoil,
  CASE WHEN cards.hasNonFoil IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN cards.hasNonFoil = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS hasNonFoil
FROM cards
views.description: Normalized per-card canonical attributes and identifiers. One row per card (prints/face), preserving key ids and commonly filtered fields; cleans obvious boolean/int flags and exposes side/uuid for multi-face detection.

views.name: card_legalities_65
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  legalities.id AS id,
  legalities.uuid AS uuid,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status
FROM legalities
views.description: Each legality row per card UUID/format. Useful to filter cards by format legality statuses (e.g., legal/illegal in a given format).

views.name: card_rulings
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  rulings.id AS id,
  rulings.uuid AS uuid,
  rulings.date AS date,
  rulings.text AS text
FROM rulings
views.description: Each ruling per card UUID with date and ruling text. Useful to filter cards with specific rulings or to find cards by ruling text/date.

views.name: cards_core_67
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.artist AS artist,
  cards.layout AS layout,
  cards.borderColor AS borderColor,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.types AS types,
  cards.subtypes AS subtypes,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.setCode AS setCode
FROM cards
grain: cards.uuid -- one row per unique card primary record (cards table row)
views.description: One-row-per-card primary card metadata (canonicalized essential columns) useful as the base cohort for card-level queries and joins to translations, legalities, sets, and rulings.

views.name: foreign_names_by_language
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.id AS "foreign_data.id",
  foreign_data.uuid AS "foreign_data.uuid",
  foreign_data.language AS "foreign_data.language",
  foreign_data.name AS "foreign_data.name",
  foreign_data.text AS "foreign_data.text",
  foreign_data.flavorText AS "foreign_data.flavorText",
  foreign_data.type AS "foreign_data.type",
  foreign_data.multiverseid AS "foreign_data.multiverseid"
FROM foreign_data
grain: foreign_data.id -- one row per foreign_data translation record
views.description: Translations / foreign-data rows for cards; links foreign_data rows to card uuid and exposes language, localized name, localized text/type/flavor for quick filtering and selection of localized values.

views.name: cards_with_translations
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",
  cards.id AS "cards.id",
  cards.name AS "cards.name",
  cards.artist AS "cards.artist",
  cards.layout AS "cards.layout",
  cards.borderColor AS "cards.borderColor",
  cards.type AS "cards.type",
  foreign_data.language AS "foreign_data.language",
  foreign_data.name AS "foreign_data.name as foreign_name",
  foreign_data.text AS "foreign_data.text as foreign_text"
FROM cards
JOIN foreign_data ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
grain: foreign_data.id -- one row per card translation (cards row joined to a foreign_data row); cards without translations will be absent unless outer join is used in question_ops
views.description: Denormalized view linking primary card rows to their foreign_data translations (if any). Exposes both the English primary values and the localized values side-by-side for filtering and output.

views.name: sets_core_info
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  code AS code,
  name AS name,
  baseSetSize AS baseSetSize,
  block AS block,
  releaseDate AS releaseDate,
  type AS type
FROM sets
views.description: One-row-per-set core metadata including identifying and descriptive attributes used for filtering, joining, and presentation.

views.name: set_translations_by_set
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  setCode,
  language,
  translation,
  id
FROM set_translations
views.description: All translations for sets: one row per translation entry linking a set code to a language and its translation text. Useful to list available translations for any set.

views.name: sets_with_translations_72
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  sets.code AS code,
  sets.name AS name,
  sets.baseSetSize AS baseSetSize,
  sets.block AS block,
  set_translations.setCode AS setCode,
  set_translations.language AS language,
  set_translations.translation AS translation,
  sets.id AS sets_id,
  set_translations.id AS set_translations_id
FROM sets
JOIN set_translations
  ON set_translations.setCode = sets.code
views.description: Denormalized view joining sets core info with their translations. One row per (set, translation) useful for answering which languages a set has translations in and showing set metadata alongside each translation.

views.name: card_legalities_denorm
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS card_id,
  cards.uuid AS card_uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS set_code,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status,
  cards.hasContentWarning AS hasContentWarning,
  legalities.id AS legality_id
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
grain: one row per (cards.uuid, legalities.id) — i.e. one card legality record
views.description: Denormalized row-level view joining cards with their legalities rows so each row represents one card/format legality entry, exposing card identity, set and legal status plus content-warning flag for filtering and aggregation.

views.name: cards_core_attributes_74
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS card_id,
  c.uuid AS card_uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS set_code,
  -- prefer release date from cards_core_6 or cards_core_33 if available; fall back to NULL
  COALESCE(c6.release_date, c33.releaseDate, NULL) AS release_date,
  c.types AS types,
  c.rarity AS rarity,
  -- ensure canonical INTEGER (0/1) for flags
  CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning IS NOT NULL THEN c.hasContentWarning
       WHEN c15.hasContentWarning IS NOT NULL THEN c15.hasContentWarning
       ELSE 0 END AS hasContentWarning,
  CASE WHEN c.isReprint IS NOT NULL THEN c.isReprint ELSE 0 END AS isReprint,
  CASE WHEN c.hasFoil IS NOT NULL THEN c.hasFoil ELSE 0 END AS hasFoil,
  CASE WHEN c.hasNonFoil IS NOT NULL THEN c.hasNonFoil ELSE 0 END AS hasNonFoil
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN cards_core_6 c6 ON c.uuid = c6.uuid
LEFT JOIN cards_core_33 c33 ON c.id = c33.id
LEFT JOIN cards_core_15 c15 ON c.uuid = c15.uuid
views.description: Normalized card-level attributes useful for many analyses: primary identifiers, name, set, release date, printed types and flags (content warning, promo/reprint/foil) with canonical typed columns.

views.name: legalities_by_format
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT legalities.uuid) AS legal_card_count
FROM legalities
GROUP BY legalities.format, legalities.status
views.description: Aggregated counts of card legalities by format and status. Produces counts of distinct cards (by uuid) per (format,status) — useful as denominators for percent calculations.

views.name: cards_core_76
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.power AS power,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.subtypes AS subtypes,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost
FROM cards
views.description: Normalized per-card basic attributes and canonical identifiers. Clean/standardize key card fields (expose uuid, power, other identifying columns and simple canonical flags). Do not apply question-specific filters.

views.name: foreign_data_by_language
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.uuid AS uuid,
  foreign_data.language AS language,
  foreign_data.name AS "name as foreign_name",
  foreign_data.text AS "text as foreign_text",
  foreign_data.flavorText AS "flavorText as foreign_flavor",
  foreign_data.multiverseid AS multiverseid,
  foreign_data.id AS id
FROM foreign_data
grain: one row per foreign_data.id (one row per foreign translation entry)
views.description: Foreign-language translations / foreign_data associated to cards, one row per foreign_data entry. Exposes uuid and language and translated fields for easy existence checks and joins to cards.

views.name: card_power_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  uuid,
  CASE WHEN power IS NULL OR power = '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_power
FROM cards_core
views.description: Cohort of cards selected by whether they have a missing or wildcard power value. Exposes card uuid and a boolean flag 'no_power' that can be used to compute denominators and to join with language data for numerators.

views.name: foreign_translations_by_multiverse
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.multiverseid AS multiverseid,
  foreign_data.uuid AS uuid,
  foreign_data.language AS language,
  foreign_data.name AS name,
  foreign_data.text AS text,
  foreign_data.flavorText AS flavorText,
  foreign_data.type AS type,
  foreign_data.id AS id
FROM foreign_data
views.description: All foreign-language translations/variants for cards keyed by multiverse id. One row per foreign_data record; useful to filter by multiverseid to find translated name, text, flavorText, language and the card uuid.

views.name: card_foreign_with_card_info
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.id AS "foreign_data.id",
  foreign_data.multiverseid AS "foreign_data.multiverseid",
  foreign_data.language AS "foreign_data.language",
  foreign_data.name AS "foreign_data.name",
  foreign_data.text AS "foreign_data.text",
  foreign_data.flavorText AS "foreign_data.flavorText",
  foreign_data.type AS "foreign_data.type",
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",
  cards.name AS "cards.name AS card_name",
  cards.multiverseId AS "cards.multiverseId AS card_multiverseId",
  cards.setCode AS "cards.setCode"
FROM foreign_data
LEFT JOIN cards ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized rows combining foreign_data and card basic identity (by uuid) to make queries that target either multiverseid or card attributes simpler. One row per foreign_data record joined to its card (if present).

views.name: cards_row_level
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.layout AS layout,
  c.isTextless AS isTextless,
  c.text AS text,
  c.type AS type,
  c.types AS types,
  c.subtypes AS subtypes,
  c.rarity AS rarity,
  c.setCode AS setCode
FROM cards c
views.description: Base row-level cohort of all card records with key identity, layout, and text-related flags/fields exposed for filtering and aggregation.

views.name: cards_layout_text_flags
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  -- canonicalize layout: treat NULL/empty as 'normal', otherwise lower-case trimmed value
  CASE
    WHEN TRIM(IFNULL(c.layout, '')) = '' THEN 'normal'
    ELSE LOWER(TRIM(c.layout))
  END AS layout_canonical,
  -- canonicalize isTextless flag: accept possible column name isTextless on cards table; if absent, treat as 0
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(c.isTextless, 0) = 1 THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_textless_bool
FROM cards AS c
views.description: Normalized view that canonicalizes layout and textless flag values and exposes a boolean indicator for textless; useful for consistent filtering across queries.

views.name: cards_by_layout_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  layout AS layout,
  isTextless AS isTextless,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards
GROUP BY layout, isTextless
views.description: Pre-aggregated counts of cards per layout and textless flag (raw), providing counts by layout and by isTextless status to speed percentage and distribution calculations.

views.name: sets_core_84
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  code AS code,
  mcmName AS mcmName,
  name AS name,
  releaseDate AS releaseDate,
  type AS type
FROM sets
views.description: One-row-per-set basic set metadata and identifiers. Exposes canonical set identifiers and human-readable fields used to filter or join to translations and cards.

views.name: set_translations_by_set_85
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  set_translations.id AS id,
  set_translations.setCode AS setCode,
  set_translations.language AS language,
  set_translations.translation AS translation
FROM set_translations
views.description: One-row-per-set-translation language entry. Links a set (by set code) to its translations and available language names. Useful to list languages available for a set or to join translations to set metadata.
